description: This file defines constants, classes, and enums related to the UI canvas components in a macOS application. It manages window properties, layout sizes, and panel behaviors, and sets up logging for the canvas subsystem.

classes.name: CanvasPanel
classes.description: A custom NSPanel that overrides properties to be key and main window.

methods.name: canBecomeKey
methods.description: Overrides NSPanel property to allow the panel to become a key window.

methods.name: canBecomeMain
methods.description: Overrides NSPanel property to allow the panel to become the main window.

methods.name: isPanel
methods.description: Determines if the CanvasPresentation is of type panel.
